name: Easy Palm
description: Let the palm fall along the one line where the target's guard is open and add no more force than that.

name: Yielding Stance
description: Settle the body so each push finds nothing to lean on and spends itself in the air.

name: Easy Step
description: Take the pace that needs the least effort and find the body already past the strike.

name: Way Sense
description: Open the senses without reaching and learn where the nearest quiet line lies through the crowd.

name: Calm Tao
description: Slow the user's breath until the qi runs even and the next move comes at half its usual cost.

name: Unforced Strike
description: Throw a blow at the moment the body would move anyway so the strike costs almost no effort.

name: Soft Turn
description: Turn the forearm just enough to let a blow slide past on the line it was already taking.

name: Unforced Step
description: Step where the weight is already falling and let the body carry itself the rest.

name: Open Gap
description: Spot the open line in a foe's stance and hold it in mind for the next blow.

name: Tao Touch
description: Touch the target's wrist as it tenses and let their own effort undo their grip.

name: Rooted Ease
description: Sit into the legs with no strain so that a shove finds a body that is simply there.

name: Direct Palm
description: Send a plain palm along the straightest path to the target and stop it where it must.

name: Easy Guard
description: Hold a plain guard that asks no more of the arms than the weight of the arms.

name: Light Pivot
description: Pivot on the ball of one foot and let the turn carry the body clear.

name: Pattern Glance
description: Read the repeat in a foe's rhythm with one calm glance and mark the beat after it.

name: Effortless Push
description: Push the target at the moment they lean so their own weight takes them off balance.

name: Tao Hands
description: Keep the hands soft and open and let each incoming strike find nothing to meet.

name: Settled Tao
description: Let a long breath settle the user's own scattered qi back to its even course.

name: Yielding Hand
description: Give way before a push then return the same force through the open palm.

name: Give Way
description: Step off the line of a charge at the last breath so it spends itself on empty air.

name: Light Way
description: Move on a light pace that never fights the ground or the foe's push.

name: Tao Reading
description: Read the direction a fight is already leaning and note where it will go next.

name: Slackened Grip
description: Slow the target's rising anger with an easy touch until their grip and temper both slacken.

name: Flowing Block
description: Let the arms move in a slow loop that catches and sends away every blow.
